title: Ignore example stuck waiting for audio
description: https://aurit.us/examples/ignore stays on Waiting for audio. Job daea0e6a is pending Kokoro; extracted text correctly omits the ignored paragraph. Local worker is not running so JIT never completes; SFN Batch wait is 900s.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Ignore job daea0e6a was pending then claimed. Batch FAILED because embed default voice_id is default and Kokoro tried voices/default.pt (404). Resetting job to pending with voice_id af_heart and resubmitting Batch. Product fix: default Kokoro voice af_heart in embed, router, and runner.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Live ignore job daea0e6a is done with af_heart WAV (~5.3s). Player status Ready, Play enabled. Root cause remains: embed still defaults voice_id to default, which 404s on Kokoro. Product fix in progress (af_heart default).

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: PR #10 (1fe0011) defaults Kokoro voice to af_heart in embed, router, runner, and backends, and maps legacy default. Live ignore page already plays via an af_heart regenerate; this PR stops new jobs from posting default.pt.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: PR #10 merged (bc575c3): af_heart is the Kokoro default only; Qwen keeps default. Deploying router so live POST /jobs maps Kokoro default to af_heart even before embed.js is on main.

right_now_summary: The fix is merged and deploying, while the live example plays audio with af_heart.
